verdict.rationale: The only evidence of an official WorkOS CLI is a single mention of a "WorkOS CLI migrations tool" for exporting Auth0 data. The CLI Auth items describe a Device Authorization Flow that customers use to authenticate their own command-line apps, so they are not an official WorkOS CLI and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented CLI install and command reference, CLI coverage of workspace management beyond migrations, AI/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., non-interactive or machine-readable output), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
